def load():

    return G

def solve3():
    def f(inp):
        cc=comps(inp)
        vals=[v for row in inp for v in row]
        bg=max(set(vals),key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in inp))
        marks=[(inp[b[0][0]][b[0][1]],b[0][0],b[0][1]) for b in cc if len(b)==1]
        res=[row[:] for row in inp]
        for b in cc:
            col=inp[b[0][0]][b[0][1]]
            if col==bg or len(b)==1: continue
            tl=(b[0][0],b[0][1])
            ds=sorted((abs(tl[0]-mr)+abs(tl[1]-mc),col_,mr,mc) for col_,mr,mc in marks)
            d=min(x[0] for x in ds)
            winners=[x for x in ds if x[0]==d]
            pick=min(winners,key=lambda x:(-x[2]))[1]  # LATER row wins tie
            for r,c in b: res[r][c]=pick
        return res
    return f

def f(inp):
    cc=comps(inp)
    vals=[v for row in inp for v in row]
    bg=max(set(vals),key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in inp))
    marks=[(inp[b[0][0]][b[0][1]],b[0]) for b in cc if len(b)==1]
    res=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for b in cc:
        col=inp[b[0][0]][b[0][1]]
        if col==bg or len(b)==1: continue
        ds=sorted((min(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc) for r,c in b),col_,mr,mc) for col_,(mr,mc) in marks)
        d=min(x[0] for x in ds)
        winners=[x for x in ds if x[0]==d]
        pick=min(winners,key=lambda x:(x[2],x[3]))[1]
        for r,c in b: res[r][c]=pick
    return res

import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
def solve_match(inp):
    cc=comps(inp)
    vals=[v for row in inp for v in row]
    bg=max(set(vals),key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in inp))
    marks=[]
    for b in cc:
        if len(b)==1:
            mr,mc=b[0]
            marks.append((inp[mr][mc],(mr,mc)))
    blocks=[b for b in cc if len(b)>1 and inp[b[0][0]][b[0][1]]!=bg]
    cost=np.array([[min(abs(r-mr)+abs(c-mc) for r,c in b) for _,(mr,mc) in marks] for b in blocks])
    ri,ci=linear_sum_assignment(cost)
    res=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for i,r_ in enumerate(ri):
        col_,pos=marks[ci[i]]
        for r,c in blocks[r_]: res[r][c]=col_
    return res
allok=True
